name: FND_EDP_PROT_FIELDS_B_
description: Stores the definitions of the fields which are to be protected by an external application.

columns.name: PROT_FIELD_ID
columns.description: Internal GUID to uniquely identify data protection field configuration row.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: PROTECTION_KEY
columns.description: GUID - Unique protection key.  This key will be exposed to the external application as the key for the field protection. Protection key will always contain two parts, Object and Attribute, separated by a dot(.).

columns.name: TOKENIZATION_SCHEME
columns.description:
Some attributes may require tokens to be generated for every word rather than having one token generated for the entire sentence. 
Valid Values:
ALL - Tokenize entire value into one token
WORD - Tokenize word by word

columns.name: PROTECTION_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Column being protected.

columns.name: PROTECTION_STATE
columns.description:
The type of protection configured by the external application on the field. Valid Values:
NONE - No protection on the field.
ENCRYPTED - The field will be encrypted by the external application.
TOKENIZED - The field will be tokenized by the external application.

columns.name: FIELD_SIZE
columns.description: The number of characters left un-encrypted/tokenized by the external application. These characters are primarily left unprotected to allow for sorting.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether this protection field is currently active/enabled for integration with the external application. Values: Y/N

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
